scope: INFRA-514's own pull request carries the three Envoy listener findings that no child names, as the architect decided on Envoy at 04:02Z and 04:32Z. EV-5: session-cache reads take the shared lock, expiry runs from a deadline heap, the reaper works on a snapshot, and the cacheRevisions map is bounded. EV-7: a rewatch resumes from the last revision it applied. EV-11: an unchanged heartbeat writes the interest row once per 5 min. EV-11's reaper grace is dispatch://INFRA-610, which merges and reaches all three listeners first; the root goes to review only after INFRA-610's production check. Children INFRA-179, 589-599, 605-607 and 610 own the rest of the review, and INFRA-599 owns integration.
plan: Full plan: dispatch://INFRA-514/artifact/plan-md (plan.md on the issue). Tasks in order. T0: base on main@origin; Envoy message to the INFRA-141 and INFRA-439 architects naming the functions changed; the second PR to merge rebases; stay out of INFRA-594's delivery files and INFRA-595's cistore files. T1: new benchmark and counter files that compile on the base (internal/session/registry_bench_test.go, cmd/listener/reaper_bench_test.go, internal/kvwatch/rewatch_bench_test.go, internal/cistore/rewatch_bench_test.go, cmd/listener/heartbeat_writes_test.go), plus the before numbers on the base. T2 EV-5: registry.go Get/List/LastSeen under RLock with no mutation; a min-heap of live and lastSeen deadlines, at most two items per id, with one time.AfterFunc timer; the callback re-checks the deadline; the fence is dropped once lastSeen expires (ttl>0); pruneLocked removed; LiveCount for the envoy_active_sessions gauge; store.Registry.Reap snapshots under RLock and re-checks each candidate before it deletes. T3 EV-7: bus.KeyValue.WatchAllFrom(conn, rev) over nats.go v1.50.0 jetstream ResumeFromRevision, wrapped as nats.KeyWatcher; kvwatch tracks hw and completion per generation and resumes from hw+1 when the last generation completed, Created is unchanged and hw<=LastSeq, else does a full WatchAll; Start stays a full scan; warm-up outcome 'resumed'. T4 EV-11: Upsert returns cur without writing when the row is unchanged apart from UpdatedAt and younger than store.InterestRefreshAge (5 min, from INFRA-610); the session row is still written every heartbeat (liveness; $SYS denied); the role read is INFRA-594's. T5: ./internal/session/ joins the envoy-go-race job. T6: docs (packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md, the cache-miss solution doc, CHANGELOG, .dispatch/architecture/envoy-listener.md, and the review document rows on Dispatch). T7: after numbers, simplify pass, and a PR body with one before/after table per finding. Measurement: INFRA-589's harness (main, else branch legion/INFRA-589, else archive), fresh stack, 3 listeners, steps 1x and 10x with -duration 660s, a nats-server restart at minute 6; readings: KV_envoy_interests/sessions LastSeq per heartbeat, warm-up entries and CPU after the restart, reaper pass time, delivery p99; Go benchmarks at -count 5 with benchstat.
acceptance: R1 EV-5: Get/List/LastSeen take only the shared lock and change nothing; an expired entry is absent at once and leaves the cache at its deadline with no read; Get at 3,000 sessions within 2x of 400; a reaper pass at 3,000 within 10x of 400. go test -race ./internal/session/ ./internal/store/ ./cmd/listener/; go test -run '^$' -bench 'Registry|Reap' -benchmem ./internal/session/ ./cmd/listener/
R2 EV-5: isAlive runs with no interest lock held; each candidate is re-checked before delete. go test -race -run Reap ./internal/store/ ./cmd/listener/
R3 cacheRevisions holds no entry for an id that left the cache more than one TTL ago, and a stale delivery cannot make it live. go test -race -run Revision ./internal/session/

R4 EV-7: after a completed scan, a Rewatch applies only revisions after hw (0 with no writes, exactly k after k writes); a recreated bucket, LastSeq<hw and an incomplete first scan each read in full; warm-up outcome resumed. go test -race ./internal/kvwatch/ ./internal/bus/; go test -run Restart ./cmd/listener/

findings.finding: Skipping unchanged interest writes removes the reaper's durable heartbeat clock; LastSeen is per-process; old-build reapers during rollout.
findings.answer: The clock stays the interest row's UpdatedAt, refreshed at least every 5 min. The reaper grace becomes graceWindow+5 min. That grace ships first as its own child INFRA-610 and reaches all three listeners, and the root goes to review only after INFRA-610's production check (architect 04:41-04:42Z). This answers plan review round 1's blocker. Tests: a paused session at 6 and 9 min keeps its row.

findings.finding: EV-7 coverage and semantics: the FirstSeq gap rule is too conservative; DeliverLastPerSubject ordering is assumed; the purge race; the jetstream KeyWatcher has no Error(); start still replays; CI and cistore overlap; the sweep in or out; the warm-up line.
findings.answer: Resume when the last generation completed, Created is unchanged and hw<=LastSeq. A resume is exactly as blind to purged markers and MaxAge expiry as today's same-bucket full re-read, so it is no regression. An incomplete scan always reads in full again, so no ordering assumption is made. The purge race is equal to today's. The adapter's Error() fires when Updates closes without Stop, with a test. Start stays a full scan, and the review text says so. cistore gets a new test file only. The sweep is out (INFRA-261). Warm-up outcome 'resumed' is documented.

findings.finding: EV-5 design open: heap vs sweep, the fence, Ping rate, gauge, LastSeen retention, List per scrape, the reaper re-check.
findings.answer: A deadline heap with at most two items per id and time.AfterFunc (event-driven, matching the review's fix). The re-check in the callback, and the fence kept except dropped after lastSeen expiry (safety argued). Ping no longer prunes. LiveCount for the gauge. LastSeen of an expired-but-unremoved entry answers UpdatedAt until expiresAt+ttl. The reaper snapshots and re-checks the revision before each delete.
